name: ListWithParams
run: vehicle list -s spec.vcl --network classifier:fake.onnx --parameter epsilon:0.1 --dataset trainingImages:images.idx --dataset trainingLabels:labels.idx -j

name: VNNLib
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f VNNLibQueries -o VNNLib.queries/ --network classifier:fake.onnx --parameter epsilon:0.1 --dataset trainingImages:images.idx --dataset trainingLabels:labels.idx

name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network classifier:fake.onnx --parameter epsilon:0.1 --dataset trainingImages:images.idx --dataset trainingLabels:labels.idx

name: Agda
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda

name: Rocq
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v

name: RocqVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v && rocq compile -w none -vok Rocq.v

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl --logging MaxDetail --loggingPass Loss
